title: Public Alert No. 025/2026 -Alert on the Recall Specific Batches of Antacid (Citro-Soda regular) in South Africa

products.manufacturer: Adcock Ingram Clayville manufacturing facility, Johannesburg

summary: NAFDAC relays a South African (SAHPRA) recall of Citro-Soda Regular antacid/urinary alkalinizer made at Adcock Ingram's Clayville plant, Johannesburg, over possible contamination. Affected: all batches starting with 'C', expiry on or before Nov 2027, in 60g, 120g and 4g x 30 sach
